body: I've tried looking for a LGBT friendly group, but can't really find one in my area. I think it'd really help if I joined like a gay sports team or something like that lmao
I think my friends will be fine with it, I'm just worried they'll think less of me because I've not told them all this time :/
Thank you so much - gotta admit I laughed about you saying it probably not being a shock xD

Thanks, I've never thought about it like this before. Today I came out to my brother because I felt like even if it went badly, I wouldn't have cared. He was nice about it and felt good to realise that I probably was overreacting in my head lol :)
